caption: A dented ping-pong ball is dropped into a bowl of very hot water, and the dent pops back out.

sa.check: A ping-pong ball with a dent in it.
The ball is dropped into a bowl of hot water.
The drop comes first and the dent's popping out follows.

pc.expect: The dent moves outward until the ball's surface is round again, and the ball stays one hollow sphere of the same size.
pc.fail: The dent deepens instead of popping out; or a new dent appears elsewhere on the ball; or the ball swells much larger than it was; or the ball turns into another shape such as an egg.

pc.expect: The change runs one way in the hot water: the dent only comes out and does not return.
pc.fail: The dent pops out and then presses back in while the ball stays in the hot water; or the dent comes and goes in turn; or the dent pops out before the ball reaches the water; or the ball's surface ripples back and forth.

pc.expect: The ball floats at the surface, bobbing, and the water stays level in the bowl.
pc.fail: The ball sinks to the bowl's floor and stays; or hangs motionless in mid-water; or rises out of the water and hangs above it; or the water's surface tilts and stays tilted with the bowl level.

pc.expect: The drop has an effect: the water splashes and ripples where the ball lands and the ball is wetted.
pc.fail: The ball enters and the surface stays glassy; or the water ripples before the ball reaches it; or the ball stays dry while floating; or the dent pops out while the ball is still in the air above the water.

pc.expect: One ball and one bowl; the ball stays in the water and nothing passes through the bowl.
pc.fail: The ball vanishes; or a second ball appears; or the ball passes through the bowl's wall; or the bowl changes shape.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The ball's colour and markings, the bowl and the surroundings stay the same.
pc.fail: The ball changes colour; or its printed markings change; or the bowl changes pattern.
